name: historical-budget-labels
goal: The component panel says frozen with a number only where a reviewed limit is known for that revision, from the record's own finding or the ledger of the revision; where the manifest merely declares a freeze it says that no reviewed limit is recorded there, as it already does for emitted sizes

evidence: On the original preview the panel of kernel.impact-kernel at 1d5f793 read 'source-bytes: 35172 bytes · frozen' and 'dependencies: 1 count · frozen', although record b141c19f has no baseline: its findings are missing-baseline with null baselines (Codex scratch work/root-historical-budget-label-review.json). The label helper printed 'frozen' for any measured value, taking the manifest's declared policy for a limit. Expected: 'frozen at <number>' only where a reviewed limit is known for that revision, from the record's finding or the ledger of the revision; otherwise that a freeze is declared and no reviewed limit is recorded there; unavailable and partial wording unchanged; the record unchanged.

work/logs/stage-f-budget-labels-unit-RED.log: packages/reports/test/utils/harness-budget.test.ts, 2 failed on the unchanged helper. work/logs/stage-f-budget-labels-RED.log: the strengthened tests/e2e/harness-emitted.spec.ts against the console built before the change, 3 failed at desktop, tablet and mobile: the first record of the fixture's packer, which has no baseline, read 'source-bytes: 95 bytes · frozen complexity: 1 points · frozen dependencies: 0 count · frozen'.

reports.function.harness-budget decides the limit of a line from the record's finding, else the ledger of the revision, else says the freeze is only declared; it also says what an exceeded value grew from and to. The unit view of a revision carries the reviewed source limits its ledger holds (function.budget-reviews frozenLimits, function.revision-registry), so a unit a record did not judge still shows its real limit and a unit nobody reviewed shows none. reports.component.harness-harness-unit passes both and reads a source figure only from the unit's own measurement. One existing unit expectation that encoded the old label ('not measured at this revision' with limit 'frozen') was corrected to the new wording.
